_comment: Goal U10 registered the historical t8n cases Jaune refused; units U11a (Shanghai, Cancun) and U11b (London, Paris) resolved four of them, so hist-transfer-london, hist-transfer-merge (Paris), hist-transfer-shanghai and hist-transfer-cancun now conform against their goldens. U6b added hist-selfdestruct-empty-berlin. The seven remaining forks are declared but unimplemented (Fork.rules? is none), so `jaune t8n` fails before reading any input with UnsupportedForkError, exactly as `lake exe jaune --rules <fork>` does. These cases are never marked passing: the gate requires the refusal, with this reason, and the goldens (generated from the pinned target) record the behavior later units will conform to.
